paired.method: exact two-sided binomial test over the discordant pairs (McNemar)
paired.row_loss_rate_upper95_note: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound on the probability that a capability row which passes without the remap fails with it; rows the suite never flipped are not evidence of absence beyond this bound

exposure.note: the verdict is bounded by exposure: a suite where the table rarely fires cannot measure the cost of rules it never fires

verdict.statement: both arms pass and fail the same 241 rows (0 discordant pairs, McNemar p=1); this suite and decode found no capability difference. That is a measured absence on 241 rows, not a general no-loss claim

limits: A deterministic greedy pass on one quantized artifact at one cap, with the client-stepped loop as the only decoder under test. The suite is the authored 241-row wave; a pass is the shipped grader's word, not a second opinion. Per-rule attribution lists the entry that fired on a failing row; the bias is the only difference between the arms, but a divergence can compound after the triggering step, so the table is evidence of attribution, not a per-token causal proof.
scope: Retention falsifier: the authored 241-row capability suite decoded through the documented client-stepped remap loop, both arms at one cap, graded by the shipped score_response. The off arm carries no logit_bias. Paired by row id; the arms are never averaged.
